description: Approvers are people who decide held actions. Create a dedicated approver key (shown once) before granting approval actions; give it to that person, never to an agent. Only an active approver key can approve, reject or reopen actions in the dashboard.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_create_approver
title: Create an approver key
